Projects by MaxLananas

These are selected projects with enough documentation to explain their purpose, environment and limitations. They connect the Minecraft builds in this portfolio with client mods, server plugins, an Axiom addon and web or desktop development.

Each page links to its evidence and source repository. An adapted fork is identified as such, and planned features are not described as released functionality.
